data.name: Sharvuksha
data.gender_notes: Sharvuksha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name for a girl derived from the Sanskrit words 'Sharvu' meaning Goddess Sharvani, 'Ishwara' meaning God, and 'Ksha' meaning energy. This name signifies the power and strength of the goddess, as well as her role in the creation and sustenance of the universe. The name Sharvuksha carries the meaning “Goddess Sharvu + Ishwara (God) + Ksha (Energy)” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharvuksha usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess sharvu + ishwara (god) + ksha (energy) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: This name is believed to invoke the blessings of the goddess Sharvani, who is the embodiment of strength, nourishment, and prosperity. It is also a reminder of the divine energy that sustains all of creation.
data.etymology: Sharvuksha belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess Sharvu + Ishwara (God) + Ksha (Energy).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharvuksha total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

Sharvani is one of the 64 Yogini goddesses in Hindu tradition, renowned for her power, knowledge, and wisdom. The name Sharvuksha reminds us of the importance of spiritual strength and the blessings of the divine feminine. It also reflects the reverence and respect for the divine goddesses in Hindu culture.

This name symbolizes the divine grace and boundless wisdom of Lord Shiva, who is believed to reside in the infinite expanse of the universe. It signifies the deep connection between the individual and the divine, encouraging one to seek knowledge and spiritual growth through the grace of the Supreme Lord.
